meta.title: 压纹郁金香几个要点
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 郁金香要点

scenes.title_cn: 三层推纹：逐层减少推距
scenes.title_en: Three Push Layers: Shrink Each Push
scenes.context: 三层推纹：从中间出发，逐层减少推距。郁金香的基本结构是三层堆叠，每一层推的距离比上一层短。语域：咖啡教学，结构讲解。
sentences: Three push layers, starting from the middle.
Shrink the push distance each layer.
一层比一层短，形成堆叠。
Each layer shorter, building a stack.
paraphrase: 推纹 → push layers / pushed lines
推距 → the push distance / how far you push
push distance · how far you push
scenes.speak: Three push layers, starting from the middle. Shrink the push distance each layer. Each layer shorter, building a stack.

scenes.title_en: Pushing Too Much vs. Not at All
scenes.context: 左边推太多会开裂，右边不推就变成平直的叶子。推的力度要正好：太多开裂，太少没层次。语域：咖啡教学，正反对比。
sentences: Pushing too far on the left cracks the pattern.
右边不推，变成平直的叶子。
Not pushing on the right leaves a flat leaf.
The push force must be just right.
scenes.speak: Pushing too far on the left cracks the pattern. Not pushing on the right leaves a flat leaf. The push force must be just right.

scenes.context: 正确效果：边缘内卷，有褶皱层次。郁金香要边缘向内卷、有褶皱感，才有立体层次。语域：咖啡教学，正确示范。
sentences: The right result: the edges curl inward.
a plump tulip（饱满的郁金香）
paraphrase: 边缘内卷 → edges curl inward / rolled edges
褶皱层次 → pleated layers / ruffled texture
scenes.speak: The right result: the edges curl inward. With a pleated, layered look. That's a full, plump tulip.
